claims.claim: Core lifecycle works: create, validate, read, info, patch, export
Every mutation is attributable: patch commands require agent/action (or explicit --no-decision); fields_changed computed from the patch
Parallel fan-out is safe by construction: namespace isolation enforced, conflicts detected with provenance, policies fold deterministically
Agents don't trip on the CLI: inline JSON, --set, --append, BOM tolerance, skip-guide, read aliases
Teaching hints are never wrong: no stale-view hint when patched keys are data-bound in the view
TOON encoding saves >=30% vs minified JSON on uniform/tabular data (prose number published as measured, no threshold)
CLAN's fixed injection scaffolding is bounded: skip-guide intercept <= 3,000 chars regardless of document size
spec/agent-guide.md is byte-identical across all files and hops (prompt-cache precondition)
Decision-chain two-tier compression: verbatim window intact, tail rationales compressed, pinned never compressed, all other fields verbatim
Final artifacts carry the five handoff layers (spec §22): L1-L4 by construction; L5 once flows declare requirements
Delta-per-hop injection keeps per-hop injected size ~flat on sequential chains
The byte-stable guide produces real provider prompt-cache hits across agent invocations
Revision-loop pipelines: CLAN patch path authors materially fewer output chars than ad-hoc file editing at equal fidelity
A revision pipeline's final chain attributes every mutating hop
Sequential chains: CLAN distilled re-injection beats ad-hoc accumulating re-reads as chains lengthen (crossover by ~hop 10)
At the synthesis hop, CLAN's merged injection beats ad-hoc re-reading all inputs
Nothing is silently lost: all requested edits present in final, untouched fields byte-stable, file validates
Agents recover from every CLI error without orchestrator help
Unguided agents reach protocol competence from agent-help alone
Human involvement is provable in the artifact (edited_by, patch fold-in)
One document can transform radically per hop (view + schema) with zero context loss
Cold resume from a single file beats resuming from a directory
The artifact survives a vendor/model boundary; conventions don't
